`final class VertexBuffer`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.vertex` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [VertexBuffer.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/vertex/VertexBuffer.java)

The vertices of one draw, in the fixed 32-byte layout that every backend reads.

## Description

The [`Tessellator`](/reference/drawing/tessellator/) fills a `VertexBuffer` and hands it to `draw(...)` of the render bridge.
Every vertex takes `STRIDE` bytes, laid out as [`VertexAttribute`](/reference/pipeline/vertexattribute/) describes: position, texture coordinate, color, normal.
The flags tell which optional attributes the draw wrote: the backend gives the others the texture coordinate `(0, 0)` and the normal `(0, 0, 1)`, or completes them with [`VertexFill`](/reference/pipeline/vertexfill/), and the translated shader takes the current color of the render state for a buffer without colors.
